cases.title: Analytic: the tool's name for a point («P₁») can be used, so k is solved with both values
cases.lookFor: One point P₁ on the ellipse, row 2 still says «הכלי קרא לנקודה P₁», and asking «k» answers «k = 1 או 13/5» (13/5 drawn as a fraction).
cases.before: The point was renamed P₂, P1 became a second point on the ellipse, and k was undetermined.

cases.title: Analytic: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» reaches the other value of k
cases.lookFor: Pressing «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves P₁ to the other solution (k = 1, P₁ = (0, −1)).
cases.before: No second configuration: k was free.

cases.title: Analytic: another letter is a new point, and P₁ keeps its name
cases.lookFor: P₁ = (k−1, k−2) plus a separate point P₂ on the ellipse. P₁ is not renamed.
cases.before: The two names were swapped: the coordinate point became P₁ and the new point P₂ only by accident.

cases.title: Analytic (refusal): the tool's name used for a different point is refused
cases.lookFor: «P1(2, 3)» is refused with the existing name-clash message; the point at (1, 2) keeps P₁.
cases.before: Recorded, and the earlier point was silently renamed P₂.

cases.title: Analytic: the origin's name O can be used by a later line
cases.lookFor: The triangle's vertex O is the origin point itself: one O at (0, 0), no second free O.
cases.before: The origin was renamed P₁ and the triangle got a separate free O.

cases.title: Analytic: the ends of a chord on an ellipse get no locus chip
cases.lookFor: No «הצג מקום גאומטרי» on any row.
cases.before: Chips for A and B on the chord row.

cases.title: Analytic: a chord with a direction gives its midpoint a chip, and only it
cases.lookFor: Exactly one chip, «הצג מקום גאומטרי», on M's row; none on the chord row (read from the shot: only the M row carries it).
cases.before: Chips for A, B and M.

cases.title: Analytic: D on the ellipse in the focus triangle gets no chip
cases.before: A chip for D on the triangle row.

cases.title: Analytic (unchanged): the perpendicular-bisector point keeps its chip
cases.lookFor: M's row still has «הצג מקום גאומטרי».

cases.title: 3-D: a fact the cube already holds is its own row, with the notice
expect: זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.
cases.lookFor: The last line is a second row with the notice «זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.»; the cube does not move.
cases.before: Answered «כבר קיים» and added no row (2-D, analytic and complex already did this since 12 Nov).

cases.title: 3-D (refusal): a contradiction is still refused
cases.lookFor: «AB ∥ AD» is refused: «הטענה לא מתקיימת בציור — בדקו את החישוב».
